blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateGiftCardInCartStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that a gift card is present in a cart. It throws an error
if the gift card is not found in the cart's gift cards.

children.name: ValidateGiftCardInCartStepInput
children.description: Input to validate that a specific gift card is applied to a cart.
